 (lambda p: p[0]*t/(p[1]+t)+p[2]*A**3*t**p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*t)+p[5]*A**p[6], [7,1,0.1,1,0.1,0.2,2]),
'M7: a*t/(b+t)+c*A^3+d*A^3*t^e+f':
 (lambda p: p[0]*t/(p[1]+t)+p[2]*A**3+p[3]*A**3*t**p[4]+p[5], [7,1,0.1,-0.1,1,0]),
'M8: a*t/(b+t)+c*A^3*t^d*exp(-e t)+f*A^g*t^h':
 (lambda p: p[0]*t/(p[1]+t)+p[2]*A**3*t**p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*t)+p[5]*A**p[6]*t**p[7], [7,1,0.1,1,0.1,0.2,2,0.5]),
'M9: a*t^b/(c+t^b)+d*A^3*t+e*A^3+f*A^g':
 (lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1]/(p[2]+t**p[1])+p[3]*A**3*t+p[4]*A**3+p[5]*A**p[6], [7,1,1,0.1,0.1,0.2,2]),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for name,(f,p0) in models.items():
    best=None
